notes: USMLE Content Outline 2026 explicitly includes pacemaker dysfunction, including failure to sense and failure to capture, in the Cardiovascular System dysrhythmia content.
Current NCBI Bookshelf guidance defines failure to capture as a pacing impulse that is not followed by an evoked P wave or QRS complex and distinguishes output failure, undersensing, and oversensing.
A peer-reviewed pacemaker troubleshooting review independently supports the same ECG distinction.

blueprint.competency: Patient Care: Diagnosis, including history and physical examination
official_outline_path: Pacemaker dysfunction, including failure to sense and failure to capture

duplicate_gate.amyloid_rejected_overlap: Canonical Q0608 contains hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis.
duplicate_gate.carcinoid_rejected_overlap: Canonical Q0365 contains serotonin-producing neuroendocrine tumor with right-sided valvular fibrosis.

claim_audit.failure_to_capture: PASS — visible pacing spike without subsequent evoked P wave/QRS.
claim_audit.output_failure: PASS — expected pacing spike is absent.
claim_audit.undersensing: PASS — intrinsic activity is not detected and pacing can occur inappropriately.
claim_audit.oversensing: PASS — non-target signals are sensed and pacing is inappropriately inhibited.
claim_audit.pacemaker_mediated_tachycardia: PASS — produces an inappropriate rapid paced rhythm, not isolated noncaptured impulses with pauses.

option_audit.failure_to_capture: Uniquely explains delivered ventricular pacing spikes that are not followed by ventricular depolarization.
option_audit.output_failure: Contradicted by clearly visible pacing spikes.
option_audit.undersensing: Contradicted by intact ventricular sensing and by the abnormality occurring after a delivered stimulus.
option_audit.oversensing: Would inhibit pacing rather than produce a visible pacing spike without a QRS response.
option_audit.pacemaker_mediated_tachycardia: Would produce tachycardia rather than pauses from noncapture.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A ventricular pacing spike represents delivered output. When the spike is not followed by a QRS complex, the myocardium has not been captured. The vignette explicitly confirms output and intact sensing, isolating capture failure.
adversarial_second_pass.output_failure_attack: Output failure cannot explain visible ventricular pacing spikes.
adversarial_second_pass.undersensing_attack: Undersensing concerns failure to recognize intrinsic activity, not failure of myocardium to depolarize after a delivered stimulus.
adversarial_second_pass.oversensing_attack: Oversensing causes inappropriate pacing inhibition, so the key abnormality would be missing pacing impulses rather than noncaptured visible spikes.
adversarial_second_pass.tachycardia_attack: Pacemaker-mediated tachycardia produces a rapid paced ventricular rhythm and does not explain pauses after isolated pacing spikes.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No pacing-voltage threshold, lead impedance value, battery voltage, programmed rate, or device-specific parameter is asserted.
